flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4173/ then Open Hati with no saved data (if any bills or people exist, @v16:"clear this site's browser storage and reload").
Add the people Ana, Ben and Cy.
Click Add bill and enter the name Rent.
Enter the amount 1,000.00 and choose all three people, Ana, Ben and Cy, with an equal split.
Save the bill and look at each person's share of the bill.
Assert Ana's share shows 333.34.
Assert Ben's share shows 333.33.
Assert Cy's share shows 333.33.
Store The shares shown for Ana, Ben and Cy, in that order, as one comma-separated line as 'equal_split_shares'.

summary:
Opened Hati with no existing people or bills.
Added Ana, Ben, and Cy, then created a bill named Rent for 1,000.00.
Split the Rent bill equally among all three people and saved it.
The saved bill shows Ana's share as 333.34, Ben's as 333.33, and Cy's as 333.33.
one_liner: created and equally split a Rent bill on Hati

bills_or_people_exist.query: whether bills or people is present (in the People and Bills lists)
bills_or_people_exist.human_description: Checking whether any people or bills are present
bills_or_people_exist.subject: bills or people
bills_or_people_exist.code_js: (() => { const people = [...el(4).querySelectorAll('[role="listitem"], li')].some(x => { const t = (x.innerText || x.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase(); return t && !/^no people yet$/.test(t); }); const bills = [...el(31).querySelectorAll('[role="listitem"], li')].some(x => { const t = (x.innerText || x.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase(); return t && !/^no bills yet$/.test(t); }); return people || bills; })()
